# DeviationScalingIndex

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A metric quantifying the degree to which a system's scaling behavior deviates from the expected critical exponent, used to detect pathological states. Enables real-time monitoring of network health and early anomaly detection in neuromorphic architectures, supporting adaptive in-network computation.
